newsitem.title: UK: Greene King appoints two more executives.
newsitem.headline: Greene King appoints two more executives.

text.p: British pub and brewery group Greene King Plc said on Thursday it had appointed two more executive directors with effect from April 1, 1997.
The appointments result from the formation of brewing, brands and wholesaling business unit and from the integration of the retail pub business.
The retailing business unit will operate 450 managed houses, made up of the original 200 managed houses and the 250 Magic pubs acquired last June.
Brian Field has been appointed managing director of brewing, brands and wholesaling and Colin Mayes managing director of retailing, said the company.
